settings.title: An elegant escape with panoramic views and refined comfort.
Where modern design meets timeless luxury

settings.editor: The Horizon Deluxe Room is more than just a place to stay — it’s a sanctuary designed for travelers who appreciate elegance, comfort, and unforgettable views. With its spacious layout, floor-to-ceiling windows, and refined interior design, the suite creates an atmosphere that feels indulgent yet inviting. Every corner of the room is carefully curated to balance contemporary sophistication with a warm boutique charm.

settings.title: Enjoy panoramic balcony views, a king-size bed with plush linens, and bespoke interiors crafted for both leisure and inspiration.

settings.editor: Whether you’re beginning your day with the sunrise over the horizon or unwinding in the evening with a glass of wine, the Horizon Deluxe Room provides the perfect backdrop for memorable moments. From the luxurious bathroom amenities to the cozy lounge area, this suite is designed to inspire relaxation, connection, and a sense of belonging that stays with you long after your visit.

settings.title: Every feature curated to make your stay effortless and memorable

settings.description_text: Reserve your stay in the Horizon Deluxe Room and indulge in refined comfort, breathtaking views, and the boutique hospitality that defines Hevn.
